claims.text: Forest area is the share of land under natural or planted trees at least 5 meters tall, excluding agriculture and urban parks.
claims.support: definition Forest area (% of land area) is the share of total land area that is under natural or planted stands of trees of at least 5 meters in situ, whether productive or not, and excludes tree stands in agricultural production systems (for example, in fruit plantations and agroforestry systems) and trees in urban parks and gardens.
